question: Should device-code auth adopt the fixed 30-second operation deadline and timed-out-poll retry policy through current main's canonical OAuth HTTP helper before this PR merges?
rationale: The bug and proof are strong, but the timeout value changes auth behavior for slow networks and current main has changed the owner boundary for OAuth HTTP timeout and body handling since this branch was prepared.

options.title: Align with current main
options.body: Approve the 30-second policy, rebase, and implement it through the current SDK OAuth HTTP request lifecycle while retaining the stall and cancellation proof.

options.title: Keep a separate device-code path
options.body: Explicitly approve the provider-local signal wrapper and accept separate timeout, abort-reason, and body-read maintenance for device-code login.

recommendation.title: Align with current main
recommendation.body: Approve the 30-second policy, rebase, and implement it through the current SDK OAuth HTTP request lifecycle while retaining the stall and cancellation proof.
